title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

title: Senior QA Automation Tester

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior (Prevenção a Fraudes)
description:
Um pouco sobre nós:


A TotalPass é uma empresa que oferece benefícios corporativos para o bem estar, proporcionando acesso à diversos serviços como academias, estúdios especializados em corrida, boxe, yoga, ciclismo, treinos funcionais coletivos e desenvolvimento muscular. Temos prazer em descomplicar a vida dos nossos clientes com as nossas soluções e fazemos isso de uma forma colaborativa, em um ambiente desafiador.

Acreditamos que o bem-estar existe quando olhamos para a saúde física e mental de maneira leve, livre e integral, e ampliamos diariamente nosso olhar para entender diferentes frentes de saúde agindo juntas. Tudo isso para que as pessoas se sintam seguras em um ambiente onde é possível equilibrar o físico e o mental, de acordo com as possibilidades de suas próprias rotinas.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time de Prevenção a fraudes. Será um profissional experiente, apaixonado por descobrir padrões e insights a partir de grandes volumes de dados que gerem valor para o negócio.


Como é o time de Prevenção e Fraude?


O time de Prevenção e Fraude da TotalPass é composto por profissionais altamente qualificados e dedicados a proteger nossos clientes e nossos negócios contra atividades fraudulentas. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e metodologias avançadas para identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos de fraude. Nosso time é movido por desafios e está constantemente em busca de novas formas de melhorar a segurança e a eficiência de nossas operações.


Como será o seu dia a dia?


  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e algoritmos de machine learning para prever e detectar padrões de fraude com alto grau de precisão e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e implementar segmentações comportamentais baseada em técnicas estatísticas;
  • Construir modelos preditivos que identificam anomalias, comportamentos suspeitos e tendências de fraude com base em dados históricos e em tempo real;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos modelos;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e evoluções na área de prevenção a fraudes e implementar as melhores práticas.


Requisitos:


  • Vasta atuação em Data Science e Machine Learning;
  • Experiência em lidar com grandes volumes de dados e em manipulação de dados em ambientes de nuvem, preferencialmente AWS;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python, SQL, e experiência com frameworks de Machine Learning;
  • Visão de negócio para entender a necessidade do produto e traduzir em uma solução estratégica utilizando estatística ou métodos matemáticos;

title: Web Developer
description:
React Web Developer with strong Strapi expertise | Brazil - remote | Contractor


Job Overview

Our client is seeking a highly skilled React Web Developer with strong Strapi expertise to lead the development, optimization, and continuous improvement of our website and Headless CMS ecosystem. You will be responsible for rebuilding and enhancing the digital front-end experience using React and Strapi v5 , ensuring top-tier performance, stability, and scalability.

This role requires a proactive professional capable of taking ownership from day one—someone who can solve complex problems, implement robust solutions, and drive ongoing improvements across the platform. This is not an entry-level position.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop fast, scalable, and reliable front-end solutions using React and Strapi .
  • Rebuild, refine, and optimize existing website sections to maximize performance and conversion.
  • Maintain Core Web Vitals in the green, using real-user monitoring and observability tools.
  • Design, implement, and manage content structures, schemas, and data models in Strapi v5.
  • Integrate CMS features with analytics and marketing tools such as Vercel, Microsoft Clarity, HubSpot APIs, and Google Analytics.
  • Automate deployment workflows and repetitive development tasks to improve efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with design, content, and product teams to ensure seamless execution.
  • Ensure accurate tracking, strong server response performance, and a high-quality user experience across all devices.
  • Evaluate and responsibly incorporate AI-assisted development tools that enhance productivity without compromising code quality.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building front-end applications with React .
  • Advanced experience working with Headless CMS platforms , particularly Strapi (v4+; v5 preferred).
  • Proficiency with Vercel , GitHub, continuous deployment, and server-side integrations.
  • Solid understanding of API configuration and consumption within Headless CMS environments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and deploy fixes in real-time production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion rates and running A/B testing experiments.
  • Strong knowledge of analytics tools and CMS integrations.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.


Bonus Skills

  • Experience integrating and customizing HubSpot APIs .
  • Familiarity with SEO , CRO , and performance-driven digital strategies.
  • Previous experience working in high-growth or startup environments.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development workflows , frameworks, or tools.


If converted to full-time, you will be eligible for:

  • Flexible working hours

title: Sr. Cisco Meraki Security
description:
Sr. Cisco Meraki MX Security SME

Duration: Phase One is around 4 months , with high potential for extension into Phases Two and Three

Location: Remote from Brazil (must)

Work Hours: Standard business hours CST with flexibility for deployment windows

Expected Start Date: November 2025


Job Overview:

This role is critical to the successful execution of client’s phased deployment of Cisco Meraki MX devices and associated security technologies across multiple customer locations. Lead the technical implementation of Phase One, which includes seven sites, and will directly contribute to the customer’s digital transformation and security posture. This is a cross-functional role requiring collaboration with IT, security, and cloud teams to ensure seamless integration and operational readiness.


Job Description:

  • Conduct discovery and documentation of existing IP schema across seven customer locations.
  • Design and implement new IP subnets for Office, Wireless, and Management networks.
  • Review DHCP server configuration, scope, and scope options for each location.
  • Identify network hosts that require manual static IP modifications or changes.
  • Deploy and configure Cisco Meraki MX devices, including switch port VLAN mapping.
  • Create standardized operational templates, profiles, and dashboards for Meraki environments.
  • Establish secure VPN tunnels and configure Cisco Secure Client for endpoint protection.
  • Cisco Secure Client Integration: Ensure the use of Cisco Secure Client for secure access.
  • Endpoint and End User Connections: Create and manage connections with endpoints and end users.
  • VPN Access: Ensure VPN access is available across all devices.
  • Cloud Integration: Integrate with Azure and AWS for cloud services.
  • Integrate Cisco Duo MFA to secure access to critical applications (e.g., Pension Pro).
  • Perform Active Directory integration for centralized user management.
  • Support cloud service integration with Azure and AWS.
  • Collaborate with internal and customer teams to ensure successful deployment and knowledge transfer.
  • Participate in testing, validation, and final review phases of the project.


Must Haves:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise network deployment and configuration .
  • Proven experience with Cisco Meraki MX series, including dashboard configuration and VPN setup.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Duo MFA and Cisco Secure Client .
  • Familiarity with IP schema design, subnetting, and VLAN configuration.
  • Experience integrating cloud services (Azure, AWS) into enterprise networks.
  • Prior involvement in phased deployment projects across multiple physical locations is preferred.
  • Security
  • Meraki MX Series
  • IP Schema Design
  • Cisco Duo MFA and Cisco Secure Client


Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Additional certifications in cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) or security (e.g., CISSP) are a plus.

English Skills a Must (C1 or C2 only)


The PetroHire Advantage


We offer best-in-class support for our remote team members to ensure you can perform at your peak:

  • 100% Remote: Work from the comfort of your home base.
  • Top-Tier Equipment Provided: We provide a new laptop and essential peripherals.
  • Guaranteed Connectivity: We provide paid redundant internet and battery backup.


Key Responsibilities


The core focus of this role is tactical execution, process improvement, and organizational enablement.


Project Coordination & Change Management

  • Coordinate and track multiple, simultaneous project work streams, ensuring strict adherence to timelines and high-quality deliverables.
  • Lead and facilitate complex group workshops independently, engaging effectively with both field operations and senior office personnel.
  • Mediate and facilitate discussions to proactively resolve conflicts and manage stakeholder expectations across work streams.
  • Develop critical change management documentation, including RACI charts , Management of Change (MOC) documents, and Workstream Charters .


Business Process Mapping & Optimization

  • Perform hands-on process mapping and workflow development using modern methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma and Agile principles).
  • Collaborate with domain experts and field personnel to accurately capture complex current-state business processes.
  • Develop optimized process maps and workflows that specifically support automation and organizational efficiency goals.


Data Analysis, Documentation & Reporting

  • Perform intermediate-level data analysis and build compelling dashboards/visualizations using Power BI and Advanced Excel .
  • Create leadership-level communication materials (e.g., polished PowerPoint presentations) and work intake management documentation.
  • Support data integration and reporting from unified data environments (e.g., Snowflake).


Required Skills & Experience


  • Experience: At least 8 years post-graduation experience, ideally in a PMO, Business Analyst, or Process Improvement role.
  • Language: Must be fluent in English (C1/C2 level) to communicate effectively with U.S. leadership and teams.
  • Proficiency in project and visualization tools (MS Project, Visio, Mural, Excel, and BI platforms).
  • Strong expertise in Business Process Mapping (BPM) is mandatory.
  • Intermediate data analytics skills; familiarity with SQL or workflow automation (Power Automate) is a plus.
  • Advanced presentation, conflict management, and group facilitation skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently and lead sessions without close supervision.
  • Demonstrated intercultural competence and experience working effectively with U.S.-based teams.


Preferred Qualifications (A Strong Plus)


  • Experience within the Upstream Oil & Gas industry environment.
  • Relevant professional certifications such as PMP, CBAP, or Lean Six Sigma .
  • A mindset that embraces the 'Own It' culture : high commitment, critical thinking, and exceptional organizational skills.

title: Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;

Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;

  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software (Back-End) Pleno - Afirmativa PCD
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;

  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;

  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;

  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);

  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
  • API Rest;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;

  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (TypeScript)
description:

You will help build the foundation of the client's back-end and data systems. The role will focus on platform development using Supabase, TypeScript, and modern web frameworks, enabling robust data pipelines, operations automation, and API integrations that support the client's growing applications.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and extend back-end systems using Supabase, leveraging database, auth, and edge function capabilities
  • Develop and maintain TypeScript-based APIs and integrations that underpin the client's platform and data services
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to deliver end-to-end features and performant, user-facing experiences
  • Contribute to the evolution of the client's internal automation tools and data pipeline implementations
  • Work closely with product, data, and AI teams on new integrations from analytics and forecasting to blockchain-enabled features
  • Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability while maintaining lightweight, maintainable systems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in full stack or back-end development with strong proficiency in TypeScript
  • Practical experience with Supabase (preferred) or NextJS, Express, or other TypeScript frameworks
  • Solid understanding of API design, database schema design, and serverless architecture patterns
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Experience using AI tooling, such as Cursor and CoPilot
  • Experience working independently in Agile, distributed teams
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with AI or ML integrations at the application level
  • Knowledge of blockchain, digital asset verification, or sustainability data systems
  • Experience with data visualization, analytics tools, or geospatial data


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

corporativos, entregando soluções robustas e sustentáveis para nossos clientes. Buscamos

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow – Especialista em ITAM (HAM)
description:
A ADOX Tech continua expandindo suas capacidades na gestão inteligente de ativos

corporativos, entregando soluções robustas e sustentáveis para nossos clientes. Buscamos

um Desenvolvedor ServiceNow com sólida experiência em ITAM, especialmente no

módulo HAM (Hardware Asset Management), para fortalecer nosso time e elevar o nível

de governança de ativos.

  • Atuar na sustentação técnica do módulo ITAM, garantindo conformidade, performance e boas práticas.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada com ServiceNow, com foco em ITAM/HAM.
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em CMDB, relacionamentos e governança de dados.
  • Experiência com integração de ferramentas de inventário e automação de processos relacionados ao estate de hardware.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados, construção de relatórios gerenciais e monitoramento de KPIs de ativos.
  • Familiaridade com ITIL e melhores práticas de gestão de serviços.


Diferenciais


  • Certificações CSA, CIS-ITAM, CAD ou correlatas.
  • Experiência com SAM/SAM Pro e processos de software asset management.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com grande volume de endpoints.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de compliance e auditoria de ativos.


O que oferecemos


  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos de gestão de ativos em larga escala.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, inovador e orientado à excelência técnica.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento acelerado dentro de uma consultoria referência em ServiceNow no Brasil.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of professional full stack software development experience to join our U.K. / U.S. client. You will help build the foundation of the client's back-end and data systems. The role will focus on platform development using Supabase, TypeScript, and modern web frameworks, enabling robust data pipelines, operations automation, and API integrations that support the client's growing applications.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and extend back-end systems using Supabase, leveraging database, auth, and edge function capabilities
  • Develop and maintain TypeScript-based APIs and integrations that underpin the client's platform and data services
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to deliver end-to-end features and performant, user-facing experiences
  • Contribute to the evolution of the client's internal automation tools and data pipeline implementations
  • Work closely with product, data, and AI teams on new integrations from analytics and forecasting to blockchain-enabled features
  • Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability while maintaining lightweight, maintainable systems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in full stack or back-end development with strong proficiency in TypeScript
  • Practical experience with Supabase (preferred) or NextJS, Express, or other TypeScript frameworks
  • Solid understanding of API design, database schema design, and serverless architecture patterns
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Experience using AI tooling, such as Cursor and CoPilot
  • Experience working independently in Agile, distributed teams
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with AI or ML integrations at the application level
  • Knowledge of blockchain, digital asset verification, or sustainability data systems
  • Experience with data visualization, analytics tools, or geospatial data


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack (Node.js + React Native)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Atuar em um assessment técnico com foco em análise profunda da base atual das aplicações Web e Mobile.

— Revisar código das aplicações desenvolvidas em Node.js e React Native , avaliando qualidade, padrões utilizados e aderência às boas práticas.

— Identificar bugs, riscos, dívidas técnicas e oportunidades de melhoria técnica e arquitetural.

— Mapear integrações, APIs, serviços e dependências do sistema, garantindo entendimento completo da estrutura atual.

— Documentar os achados, pontos críticos e recomendações, apoiando o time técnico na definição dos próximos passos.

— Contribuir com insights técnicos para melhoria contínua do código e estabilidade da aplicação.


O que você precisa ter

— Forte experiência prática com Node.js e React Native (Web e Mobile).

— Vivência consistente com revisão de código (code review) e análise estrutural de aplicações.

— Conhecimento sólido de boas práticas , padrões de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código.

— Capacidade analítica para identificar problemas em bases legadas, arquiteturas pouco padronizadas e integrações complexas.

— Experiência com APIs, integrações e entendimento de dependências técnicas.

— Boa comunicação para documentar achados e conduzir discussões técnicas.


Desejável

— Experiência com arquitetura limpa, padrões de projeto ou refatoração estruturada.

— Vivência em ambientes com múltiplas integrações (REST, microserviços, filas, etc.).

— Conhecimento em TypeScript.

— Experiência prévia com auditoria de código, due diligence técnica ou assessment de sistemas.


Perfil esperado

— Olhar crítico e foco em melhoria contínua.

— Mentalidade estruturada, organizada e detalhista.

— Proatividade para propor soluções e identificar riscos técnicos.

— Autonomia e capacidade de analisar ambientes complexos.

— Curiosidade técnica e vontade de elevar o nível da base existente.


Onde você vai trabalhar

Remoto.

description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro

A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Tech Lead - Data Engineering para se juntar ao nosso time em Data Plataform.


O que você vai fazer

Como Tech Lead de Data Engineering, você será a referência técnica em nossa infraestrutura de Data Platform, liderando iniciativas relacionadas à gestão de dados de interação com nossos clientes, incluindo a elaboração de demonstrativos de vendas e extratos. Terá papel fundamental na Transformação Tecnológica, apoiando a transição de sistemas legados (Oracle, PL SQL, OpenShift) para tecnologias modernas (Spark/Scala, SQL, Databricks, Atlas, Kubernetes), garantindo a continuidade dos negócios e a minimização de riscos.


  • Você será referência Técnica: Atuando como especialista técnico, orientando o time de engenharia em boas práticas, arquitetura e decisões estratégicas de tecnologia.
  • Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar próximo a times de produto, tecnologia e negócio para entender necessidades e traduzir em soluções eficazes.
  • Evolução Tecnológica: Apoiar a modernização de sistemas e migração para ambientes em nuvem, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Projetar e apoiar integrações de novos sistemas com a infraestrutura existente, assegurando eficiência operacional.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de colaboração e aprendizado contínuo no time.
  • Conciliação de Informações: Apoiar a construção de soluções para conciliações de pequenos, médios e grandes comércios, além de fluxos regulatórios (bandeiras, BACEN, etc.).


✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência em Arquitetura de Software: Sólido conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura, engenharia de software e data engineering.
  • Gestão de Riscos Técnicos: Capacidade de identificar riscos em soluções e propor alternativas.
  • Vivência técnica com: ORACLE, PL SQL, SQL, JAVA, DATABRICKS, SPARK/SCALA;
  • Kubernetes e Cloud (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud);
  • APIs e Integrações: atuação em Integração de Sistemas: Capacidade de projetar e validar soluções interoperáveis em ambientes complexos.


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

  • Experiência em empresas de adquirência ou tecnologia.
  • Familiaridade com fluxo de extrato financeiro.
  • Atuação anterior como Tech Lead ou Especialista Técnico em projetos de modernização de plataformas de dados.

title: Salesforce Administrator (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote Salesforce Administrator with 3-5 years of Salesforce administration experience to join our U.S. client's team. You will work 10 to 15 hours per week supporting the ongoing development, configuration, and management of Salesforce across the Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Service organizations. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, a keen analytical mind, and the ability to drive business outcomes through platform optimization and insightful data analysis.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-organizational teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce environment, ensuring data integrity, system stability, and optimal performance
  • Configure, customize, and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, page layouts, and other settings to support business processes
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce Flows, reports, and dashboards to provide actionable insights and improve user productivity
  • Design and implement new features or system enhancements
  • Manage integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms, ensuring data consistency and seamless functionality
  • Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and documentation for new configurations, automation, and system updates
  • Monitor and manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and security settings in accordance with company policies
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices; recommend improvements and lead adoption of new capabilities
  • Provide user support, training, and documentation for more effective system usage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 3-5 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator in enterprise, B2B environments
  • Proficiency in Salesforce setup and configuration

title: Engenheiro de Devops Sênior
description:
A Unisys valoriza a Inclusão e Diversidade, assim, nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas, incluindo Público LGBTQIAPN+, Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Pretas, entre outros grupos.


Disposição para atuar na área de DevSecOps no papel de Engenheiro DevOps Sr, com a possibilidade de mesclar suas atividades com os Arquitetos do time.


Como será seu dia a dia:


  • Proverá suporte as equipes de desenvolvimento e testes da empresa para alavancar a automação, integração e liberação contínua de versões de software (CI/CD).
  • Interação com profissionais e processos de operações. Projetar e manter pipelines de CI/CD robustos, com integração de testes automatizados, análise de código e segurança.
  • Automatizar processos de desenvolvimento, testes, entrega e monitoramento usando ferramentas como Jenkins, Nexus, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Ansible, outros.
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura como código (IaC), garantindo consistência entre ambientes (ex: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation).
  • Configurar e administrar clusters Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Implementar práticas de DevSecOps, integrando segurança desde o início do ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Monitorar e otimizar sistemas, utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, entre outras.
  • Liderar iniciativas de transformação DevOps, definindo estratégias e metas alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e operações, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua e responsabilidade compartilhada.
  • Mentorar profissionais menos experientes, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias nos processos de entrega de software.
  • Documentar processos e arquiteturas, garantindo rastreabilidade e padronização.
  • Atuar junto aos arquitetos e engenheiros na concepção e evolução de arquiteturas robustas, escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Atuar como evangelista da disciplina Segurança/DevOps.
  • Desenvolver ferramental para automação de processos.
  • Apoiar equipe de desenvolvimento com as boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Graduação completa na área de Tecnologia (com Diploma - reconhecido pelo MEC - obrigatório).
  • Inglês avançado para participação em reuniões globais.
  • Larga experiência em definição, implantação, manutenção e execução de processos e ferramentas DevSecOps.
  • Sólida experiência em Sistemas Operacionais Windows e Linux(CentOS, RHEL e UBUNTU);
  • Experiência em ambientes complexos de rede, hardware e ferramentas para soluções de missão-crítica.
  • Comprovada Experiência na utilização de containers (Docker e Kubernetes).
  • Vivência com provisionamento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura via código (Infra As Code).
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps.
  • Verificar a viabilidade e necessidade de utilização de novas tecnologias.
  • Conhecimento em administração de ferramentas ALM e Controle de versão(Github ou Gitlab).
  • Experiência em construir e manter pipeline as code utilizando ferramentas de CI/CD (Ex: Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
  • Fluência em Python + outras linguagens de alto nível (Go,Java,.NET).
  • Vivência em ambiente Ágil e cultura DevOps.
  • Atuação com ferramentas de automação e configuração (Puppet, Ansible, Chef, Rundeck).
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de monitoramento e agregação de logs (Dynatrace, Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus, ElasticSearch).

• Dinamismo, boa comunicação e fácil relacionamento com demais profissionais.


Desejamos também, mas não é obrigatório:


  • Certificações nas áreas de DevOps, Segurança e Cloud são um diferencial.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

description:

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.


Contract Type


Full-time
