title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Senior Back-End Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software experience, including API and domain model design as well as JavaScript and Node.js development, to join our U.S. client's Platform Engineering team. The ideal candidate will design, build, and deliver high-quality, performant back-end services that power a world-class compliance and trust automation platform. The Platform Engineering team focuses on core components, such as authentication, RBAC, data architecture, and back-end infrastructure, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability across the product suite.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our clients take the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy to a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their effectiveness against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Build services and APIs in JavaScript and Node.js
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles and implement them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of back-end software development experience designing APIs and domain models with knowledge of JavaScript and Node.js
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols, such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with debugging and performance testing
  • A focus on delivering value and being action-oriented
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field


Additional Information

  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual, no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

  • Start: ASAP

description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Platform Architect
description:
Role Summary

The Platform Architect will serve as the technical “north star” for the design, integration, and evolution of the NexusOne data platform for customer deployments and large programs.

This individual will architect the platform, define integration points, and design scalable, secure solutions based on incoming enterprise requirements using the NexusOne platform. They will participate in architecture review boards and ensure that all implementations align with NexusOne’s composable, open-source design principles. This role is forward-facing and requires a customer-centric mentality.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end NexusOne platform across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments based on customer requirements and limitations.
  • Design and designate integration points for data services, pipelines, orchestration, governance, and security layers.
  • Translate solution requests and business requirements into scalable, compliant architecture blueprints.
  • Lead and participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) to align deployments with enterprise standards.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and integration frameworks .
  • Guide platform engineers and client teams in implementing best practices for security, observability, and reliability.
  • Oversee the selection, integration, and tuning of open-source components such as Airflow, Spark, Trino, YuniKorn, Superset, S3, NiFi, Ranger, and DataHub.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to evolve the NexusOne “North Star” architecture and roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with DevOps, Security, and DataOps to drive alignment and platform maturity.


Must-Have Core Skills

  • Core Expertise: Spark, Trino, Airflow, NiFi, YuniKorn, Superset, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub, S3.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Kubernetes (K8s), OpenShift (OCP), Docker, Linux.
  • Security & Governance: IAM, SSO, KMS, Kerberos, Encryption, RBAC.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus.
  • Programming: Java, Scala, Python (preferred).
  • Architecture Practices: Solution design, reference architectures, system modeling, scaling patterns.


Ideal Background

  • 8–12 years of experience designing or implementing large-scale distributed data platforms in regulated industries.
  • Proven track record as a technical architect or lead engineer at Cloudera, Databricks, AWS EMR, or similar open-source platform providers.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and operating open-source data tools across hybrid-cloud and containerized environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise governance and security frameworks (SOX, FFIEC, GDPR).
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to influence architecture decisions across engineering and client teams.


Success Criteria

  • Delivery of a validated, production-ready platform architecture that meets client requirements.
  • Positive approval outcomes from Architecture Review Boards and internal security/governance reviews.
  • Defined and documented integration standards adopted by all implementation teams.
  • Successful enablement of platform engineers and developers through patterns, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Measurable reduction in deployment friction, downtime, or rework during environment rollouts.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

description:
Objetivo:


Você será o dono da operação de Violação Comercial em Marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shoppe entre outros), liderando o ciclo completo de proteção comercial de grandes marcas no ambiente digital: monitoramento, identificação de sellers, diagnóstico de violação, denúncias estratégicas, comunicação de adequação e acompanhamento da regularização.



Descrição de Responsabilidades:



Operação e Governança


  • Liderar o fluxo completo de Violação Comercial em marketplaces: setup → hunting → triagem → discovery → comunicação → penalidades → acompanhamento.


  • Garantir o monitoramento contínuo de preços, SKUs e sellers em marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee, Magalu, Google Shopping).


  • Gerenciar processos de descoberta de sellers (CNPJ, nota fiscal, nome fantasia, múltiplos perfis).


  • Coordenar denúncias estratégicas (copyright/brand misuse) como ferramenta de identificação e adequação.


  • Pilotar a execução das trilhas de comunicação com sellers infratores até a adequação comercial.



 Relação com o Time Comercial e Canais


  • Conectar regras comerciais, PMA sugerido e diretrizes de canal com a operação prática de marketplaces.


  • Auxiliar comercial em decisões de penalidades: bloqueio de venda, corte de desconto, suspensão de canal etc.


  • Dar visibilidade dos impactos de infrações para contas estratégicas e diretoria.



Produtos, Dados e Estratégia


  • Analisar curvas de preço, reincidência e impacto por SKU, sugerindo ajustes de PMA e clusterização.


  • Mapear padrões de violação (por categoria, seller, logística, campanhas).


  • Construir dashboards de oscilação de preço e saúde de canal (base no fluxo Data Studio citado nos treinamentos → ).



Processos e Eficiência

  • Estruturar runbooks, SLAs e rituais de operação.

  • Forte entendimento de políticas comerciais (PMA sugerido, canais autorizados, preço online x físico).


  • 5–10 anos de experiência com e-commerce, marketplace, pricing ou governança de canais.


  • Histórico comprovado de operação em ambientes de alta complexidade comercial.


  • Desejável vivência em projetos de proteção de marca, compliance de preço ou inteligência de mercado.



Competências de Gestão


  • Capacidade de montar e liderar time operacional.


  • Visão crítica + capacidade analítica (dados, padrões, correlação de eventos).


  • Comunicação clara, pragmática e com postura consultiva diante da diretoria.



Soft Skills


  • Perfil investigativo (curioso, conectado aos detalhes).


  • Postura firme para lidar com sellers agressivos e grandes marketplaces.


  • Visão de negócio (margem, ruptura de canal, rentabilidade, ROI).

description:
Quem somos

Na Artefact LatAm, acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura baseada na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é aquele em que todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Nosso compromisso é construir um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque empatia é para todos, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos mentes e corações incríveis ao nosso lado! Venha ser Artefact!
Sobre a Área
O time de Staffing é o coração operacional da Artefact na América Latina, responsável por garantir que as nossas equipes estejam na configuração certa, no momento certo, para impulsionar o crescimento dos nossos clientes e da própria consultoria.
Somos o elo entre as lideranças, os gerentes de projeto e os times internos, planejando a capacidade operacional, acompanhando a dinâmica de alocação e promovendo uma experiência de excelência para todos os stakeholders, locais e globais.
Nosso dia a dia é intenso e diverso: combina análise, planejamento, relacionamento e inovação. A área está em plena expansão e oferece grande visibilidade dentro da organização, com exposição direta a diretores, sócios e times internacionais.

O que você fará
Como Analista de Operações, você será peça-chave na estruturação e evolução do time de Staffing LATAM.
 Vai atuar lado a lado com lideranças e gerentes de projeto para antecipar necessidades, otimizar o uso da capacidade regional e apoiar decisões estratégicas de alocação de talentos.
Você também terá papel ativo na transformação da área, puxando iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação e padronização de práticas que sustentem o crescimento acelerado da Artefact na região.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de entender o funcionamento da operação da empresa como um todo, desde o planejamento de capacidade até a tomada de decisão estratégica sobre alocações e demandas futuras.

  • Habilidade para estruturar, interpretar e analisar dados (Excel ou Google Sheets intermediário/avançado);
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de articulação com diferentes níveis da organização;

title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote – UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.


UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.


This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

⸻

Must-Have Qualifications

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

  • Develop and deliver audience-appropriate communications to varying levels of Client stakeholders.
  • Manage risks and issues related to Client service delivery.
  • Track action items through to closure and document decisions arising from those actions.
  • Maintain comprehensive release schedules and regularly communicate these to Clients.
  • Manage required client project Margin Targets by effective resource utilization.
  • Effective Demand Management through prioritization of tickets and escalations.
  • Establish and lead recurring governance meetings with Client including preparation of materials.
  • Review key service reports and metrics with Clients to properly align expectations.
  • Be a pro-active contributor to a support organization which is running 24x7x365. This will require the ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, and monitoring email regularly outside standard business hours.
  • Drive Continuous Service Improvements by providing feedback about improvement opportunities to internal service/product teams.
  • Be a role model to peers and other technical members of staff by looking for ways to meet and exceed challenging performance standards and targets.
  • Align with the client’s business strategy and needs to ensure that Rimini Street is providing the most relevant and valuable service and communicate those needs throughout the Service Delivery Teams.
  • Partner closely with Regional Managers of the Support Engineers/Consultants to ensure that the right set of skills are available to service client needs.
  • Monitor response, update, and resolution SLAs to ensure delivery and high client satisfaction.
  • Understand client environments and ensure changes/updates to the same are reflected in operational documentation.
  • Provide expertise, guidance, and participation during the Service Transition of Clients.
  • Develop and contribute to the reporting and measurement of Performance Management targets.
  • Communicate effectively across organizations within Rimini Street (e.g., sales, marketing, account management, support, etc.)
  • Assist in the organized knowledge transfer from key Client stakeholders and incumbent service providers to Rimini Street AMS team.
  • Act as a contact for Client emergency situations and escalation management.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Experience

· 10+ years of broad technology industry experience

· 5+ years direct SDM experience within an ITIL-aligned managed services organization required.

· Proven leadership, resource management, and financial management skills within a managed services organization required.

· Demonstrable history of managing service levels and customer relationships within a distributed service delivery managed services organization.

· Working knowledge of at least one enterprise-class ERP Application (i.e. SAP, Oracle EBS, or others) preferred.

· Hands-on experience with a major ITSM platform such as ServiceNow required.

· ITIL Foundations certification; advanced ITIL certification preferred.

· Communication to a business level in a non-English language, while not a requirement, would be beneficial.

title: Editor de vídeos curtos (shorts / Reels / TikTok)
description:
A MLPro está buscando um editor de vídeos freelancer para nos apoiar na criação de shorts para YouTube, Reels e TikTok , a partir de vídeos longos já gravados.


Nosso conteúdo é técnico/educacional , focado em Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, PMO e gestão de projetos, para serem publicados nas nossas redes sociais e Youtube (@MLProPPM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Cortar trechos de vídeos longos para criar shorts de até 40–60 segundos .
  • Adaptar do formato horizontal para vertical (9:16), mantendo bom enquadramento.
  • Inserir legendas dinâmicas , com destaque em palavras-chave, sem erros de português.
  • Seguir a identidade visual da MLPro  (cores, logo e estilo mais sóbrio, não infantil).
  • Entregar arquivos em alta qualidade, prontos para publicação nas redes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos para redes sociais (shorts, Reels, TikTok).
  • Portfólio específico de shorts/ vídeos curtos  já publicados.
  • Atenção a detalhes de áudio, texto e ritmo de edição.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com conteúdo técnico/educacional.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Vaga 100% remota, formato freelancer.
  • Pacote inicial mensal de vídeos curtos, com possibilidade de expansão conforme resultados.


Na candidatura pelo LinkedIn, anexe seu portfólio de vídeos curtos  (documento com links dos vídeos) no campo de currículo (CV) . Candidaturas sem portfólio de vídeos curtos  não serão consideradas.

description:
Código da vaga: 56026


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Desenvolvedor android venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência sólida com Kotlin e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento Android.

Conhecimento profundo em arquiteturas modernas e padrões de projeto.

Experiência com Compose , corrotinas e programação reativa.

Vivência com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação de testes.

Conhecimento em práticas de segurança e otimização de performance.

Experiência com Firebase e ferramentas de monitoramento.


Responsabilidades:

Dominar o ecossistema Android, acompanhando e aplicando as últimas atualizações do Google, incluindo novos SDKs, Jetpack e APIs.

Desenvolver aplicativos escaláveis e modulares utilizando Jetpack Compose , corrotinas , Flow e outras tecnologias modernas.

Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes unitários e de instrumentação , utilizando frameworks como JUnit , Espresso e MockK .

Implementar arquiteturas modernas como MVVM , MVI ou Clean Architecture .

Integrar e gerenciar dependências com Gradle , garantindo builds eficientes e bem estruturados.

Aplicar práticas avançadas de segurança no Android , incluindo encriptação, armazenamento seguro e proteção contra engenharia reversa.

Otimizar performance, gerenciando consumo de memória, renderização de UI e eficiência de bateria.

Trabalhar com DevOps para mobile , incluindo CI/CD , automação de testes e publicação na Google Play Store .

Atuar com observabilidade e analytics , utilizando serviços como Firebase .




Modelo - 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Analista de Requisitos Pleno
description:
A Unisys valoriza a Inclusão e Diversidade, assim, nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas, incluindo Público LGBTQIAPN+, Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Pretas, entre outros grupos.


Como será seu dia a dia:


  • Planejar e executar o gerenciamento de requisitos/regras de negócios.
  • Aplicar técnicas de elicitação de requisitos mais adequadas ao modelo de negócio e aos perfis dos fornecedores de requisitos/regras de

negócios.

  • Obter o entendimento das necessidades negociais e elicitar os requisitos funcionais e não funcionais junto aos Gestores de Negócio, Product Owners e demais fornecedores de requisitos/regras de negócios.
  • Construir e manter, com apoio dos Analistas de Requisitos, os planejamentos e demais artefatos da disciplina de requisitos afins com o papel, conforme metodologia vigente.
  • Orientar os membros da equipe quanto ao entendimento dos requisitos de software e às definições para o gerenciamento de requisitos e regras de negócios, tais como atributos e necessidades de rastreabilidade.
  • Apoiar os Analistas de Requisitos e demais membros do time nas atividades de requisitos e homologações internas e dos Gestores de Negócio.
  • Orientar os membros da equipe quanto ao entendimento das definições para a realização das atividades de requisitos.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Graduação completa em na área de Tecnologia (reconhecido pelo MEC e com diploma - obrigatório).
  • Certificações obrigatórias (pelo menos uma das seguintes ou equivalente):

a) IREB (International Requirements Engineering Board) - CPRE – FL (Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering Foundation

Level).

b) CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner)

c) PSPO I (Professional Scrum Product Owner Level I)


  • Inglês intermediário para avançado.
  • Ter domínio do processo de gerenciamento de requisitos.
  • Saber aplicar técnicas de elicitação de requisitos, tais como brainstorming, questionários, entrevista, observação, prototipação, workshops, diagramação, sabendo orientar o fornecedor de requisitos a formular a sua necessidade com precisão.
  • Ter conhecimento da notação BPMN.
  • Ter capacidade de realizar análise de cenário interno para definição de melhores práticas.
  • Saber elaborar provas de conceitos conforme cenário interno.
  • Ter conhecimento de desenvolvimento nos paradigmas de desenvolvimento Estruturado e Orientado a Objetos.
  • Ter conhecimento dos ciclos de vida de desenvolvimento de software: Cascata, Iterativo/incremental e Ágil.
  • Saber elaborar diagramas UML.
  • Ter conhecimento em modelagem de dados.
  • Saber realizar análise de testes.
  • Ter habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, para coletar insumos e reportar com efetividade ou progresso e resultado de suas atividades.
  • Possuir capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, demonstrando bom relacionamento, empatia, tolerância e colaboração.
  • Ser uma pessoa organizada e saber autogerenciar o tempo e suas atividades.
  • Ser uma pessoa capaz de tomar decisões tempestivas no seu contexto de atuação.
  • Possuir capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Facilitar e articular junto as partes interessadas, saber conduzir reuniões e ser capaz de orientar com clareza os demais membros da equipe no entendimento dos artefatos e informações gerados pelas atividades de sua disciplina.
  • Ter conhecimento dos domínios de negócio envolvidos nas soluções do itens mencionados.
  • Ter conhecimentos de tecnologia de modo que as especificações de requisitos sejam compatíveis com a arquitetura vigente.


Desejamos também, mas não é obrigatório:


  • Ter conhecimento de contabilidade e contagem de pontos de função.
  • Certificações como:


a) IREB CPRE

b) IREB Requirements Elicitation.

c) IREB Requirements Modeling.

d) IREB Requirements Management.

e) CBPA (Certified Business Process Associate).


A posição é remota, porém, caso você resida na cidade de São Paulo e regiões, e esteja a 24km do escritório da Unisys (Ponte João Dias), será presencial três vezes na semana.

title: Business Development Manager (Brazil)
description:
We’re seeking a Business Development Manager  to expand our presence across the LATAM region.


Key Responsibilities:  

  • Acquire new partners across the LATAM region (Introducing Brokers, affiliates, and white-label partners) and provide ongoing support to grow their businesses and client bases. 
  • Focus on expanding the company’s presence in key LATAM markets, driving new deposits, trading volumes, and active client acquisition. 
  • Identify and pursue business opportunities within the region, implementing strategies to strengthen market penetration and regional visibility. 
  • Build and maintain a strong network of partners, industry contacts, and potential clients to maximize business growth. 
  • Collaborate with internal teams to establish localized resources such as payment solutions, marketing initiatives, and platform support tailored to the region. 
  • Meet or exceed regional business targets by prospecting, negotiating, and closing deals that contribute directly to revenue and client growth. 
  • Ensure strong partner relationships through consistent communication, prompt issue resolution, and ongoing performance support. 
  • Provide management with insights on LATAM market trends, competitor activities, and client preferences to support strategic decisions. 
  • Represent the company at regional industry events, expos, and conferences to enhance brand awareness and identify new opportunities. 
  • Ensure all activities within the LATAM region align with company policies, regulatory requirements, and ethical business standards. 


Requirements:  

  • Proven experience as a Business Development Manager 
  • Demonstrated success managing an existing portfolio of partnerships or clients. 
  • Strong knowledge of LATAM market dynamics, business culture, and regulatory environments. 
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills. 
  • Fluency in Portuguese or Spanish is essential; English fluency is required. 
  • Based in or with strong working experience in the LATAM region. 

About us:  

At TradeQuo , we are a forward-thinking fintech company specializing in innovative trading solutions and financial products. With a dynamic platform and a tech-savvy team that works together across time zones, we strive to provide cutting-edge services to traders worldwide. As we expand, we are seeking driven individuals to help us meet exciting new challenges.

  • Strong knowledge of LATAM market dynamics, business culture, and regulatory environments.

  • Fluency in Portuguese or Spanish is essential; English fluency is required.

At TradeQuo , we are a forward-thinking fintech company specializing in innovative trading solutions and financial products. With a dynamic platform and a tech-savvy team that works together across time zones, we strive to provide cutting-edge services to traders worldwide. As we expand, we are seeking driven individuals to help us meet exciting new challenges.

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior | Arquiteto de IA Generativa (LLMs, RAG, VectorDBs)
description:
Vaga: Cientista de Dados Sênior | Arquiteto de IA Generativa (LLMs, RAG, VectorDBs)


Atuação em cliente da G5 IT — empresa de tecnologia com mais de 30 anos de mercado e forte foco em desenvolvimento de software.


Estamos buscando um Cientista de Dados Sênior com forte atuação em Arquitetura de IA Generativa para contribuir na evolução de soluções avançadas utilizando LLMs, RAG, VectorDBs e frameworks modernos de GenAI .


Como Cientista de Dados com foco em IA Generativa, você será responsável por:


  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de IA  do produto, garantindo escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e explicabilidade.
  • Liderar iniciativas com LLMs, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)  para geração de soluções seguras e contextualizadas.
  • Aplicar fundamentos de estatística, probabilidade e algoritmos de Machine Learning  (regressão, classificação, clusterização etc.) em análises e avaliações de performance.
  • Orquestrar integrações entre sistemas judiciais, serviços em nuvem e provedores de IA .
  • Projetar, implementar e monitorar pipelines envolvendo vector DBs  e frameworks de GenAI  (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, entre outros).
  • Criar e refinar engenharia de prompts  em cenários complexos e diversos.
  • Traduzir resultados técnicos em insights claros e acionáveis , comunicando descobertas e limitações a públicos diversos (técnicos e executivos).
  • Documentar experimentos, resultados e boas práticas, promovendo transparência e reprodutibilidade .
  • Evangelizar o uso responsável e eficiente da IA, representando a empresa em talks, artigos e comunidades técnicas .
  • Garantir compliance e anonimização de dados sensíveis , em linha com LGPD e regulamentações do setor público.
  • Contribuir com o desenho e evolução da arquitetura distribuída (multi-workers/processors)  conectada a sistemas judiciais e múltiplos LLMs.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento em estatística, probabilidade e algoritmos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clusterização etc.).
  • Experiência prática com Grandes Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) e técnicas de prompting, embeddings e RAG.
  • Familiaridade com o ecossistema de GenAI, incluindo frameworks e bibliotecas que aceleram o desenvolvimento com LLMs e vector databases.
  • Vivência em vector DBs (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone, Milvus ou equivalentes).
  • Sólida base em Python e Node/TypeScript para automações e integrações.
  • Experiência em arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em segurança e privacidade de dados (LGPD, PII), em especial questões de anonimização.
  • Capacidade de comunicar e apresentar insights complexos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Experiência anterior como arquiteto de soluções ou líder técnico em projetos complexos de IA.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com evals automatizados e guardrails (Rebuff, NeMo Guardrails, Truera).
  • Experiência com IA aplicada ao setor público ou jurídico.
  • Publicações, talks ou contribuições em comunidades técnicas de IA.
  • Histórico de contribuição em projetos InnerSource ou open source.

description:

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!
